events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Iguodala (GSW) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

[Observable in enhanced video] Green (GSW) enters the lane prior to the release of Nurkic's (POR) free throw attempt.
Aminu (POR) reflexively places his arm around Curry's (GSW) midsection as the pick is set and creates contact that is tactile in nature.

Nurkic (POR) establishes himself in a wide screening position in Curry's (GSW) defensive path, but contact on the pick occurs to his upper half.

Curry (GSW) sets the pick on Aminu (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Iguodala (GSW) maintains legal guarding position as marginal contact is made with Lillard (POR) at the end of his drive.

Thompson (GSW) makes marginal contact with Lillard's (POR) lower half during his upward shooting motion. Thompson then makes marginal contact with Lillard's arm after the release of his jump shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court of :00.2 remaining in the game was confirmed.
